title: Oxidation and breakdown of ascorbate to oxalate

steps.enzyme: Oxidation by oxygen, metal ions or radicals; reduction by glutathione, NADH or NADPH
steps.note: Keeps vitamin C activity; GLUT1, GLUT3 and GLUT4 move it into cells

steps.enzyme: Hydrolysis of the lactone ring, spontaneous or possibly enzyme-catalysed
steps.note: Irreversible; faster at pH 7 to 8 than at pH 3 to 5
Part is excreted in urine; minor products xylose, xylonate, lyxonate
